response.sql: WITH pair_avg AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope HAVING AVG(f.feerate) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avg), kept AS (SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_feerate, p.avg_feerate - o.mean_avg AS excess FROM pair_avg p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_feerate > o.mean_avg), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rnk FROM kept) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rnk FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rnk, orderslink

assumptions.assumption: Pairs whose feerate values are all NULL (average is NULL) are excluded from the set of pair averages, so they do not affect the overall mean of pair averages.
The mean of pair averages is an unweighted mean over pairs (each pair counts once), not a mean over individual fee rows.
